headline: Attackers exploit an AI-discovered Drupal flaw and root Palo Alto firewalls as Treasury's FinCEN pulls systems offline after an intrusion.

emerging_trends.text: AI tools now sit on both sides of the exploit chain: an Anthropic scanner found the Drupal bug attackers are hijacking sites with.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Hackers Exploit Drupal Flaw Found by Anthropic

emerging_trends.text: Package registries keep taking the first blow, with Hex.pm servers running attacker commands and WordPress pulling six backdoored WP Connect plugins.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Attackers Run Commands on Hex.pm Servers

emerging_trends.text: Credential theft has become the point of exploitation, and bots now claim cloud keys from fresh Docker images in under eight seconds.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Bots Grab Leaked AWS Keys in Seconds

topics.title: Hackers Exploit Drupal Flaw Found by Anthropic
topics.latest_developments: The Drupal security team confirmed attackers have exploited critical remote code execution flaw CVE-2026-132165 since at least Thursday, and CISA gave federal agencies three days to patch.
topics.why_it_matters: Unpatched Drupal sites face full takeover, and an Anthropic AI scanner found the bug, so AI-discovered flaws now reach attackers fast.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: CISA added two more exploited bugs: CVE-2026-132224 in Optimizely Web Experimentation, used to plant malicious JavaScript on major websites, and CVE-2026-131914 in the Idunno AntiCsrf library.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Update Drupal core immediately. Rip Idunno AntiCsrf out of legacy ASP.NET applications, because the project is defunct and a single crafted web request runs code.

sources.title: Hackers now exploit critical Drupal RCE flaw to hijack sites
Drupal Flaw Found by Anthropic Scanner Exploited in Attacks
Exploited: Abandoned Idunno.AntiCsrf library opens legacy ASP.NET apps to RCE (CVE-2026-131914)
Hackers Exploit Unpatched Flaw in Defunct Idunno AntiCsrf Library

topics.title: Researchers Map Agentic AI Attack Tradecraft
topics.latest_developments: Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 and Cisco Talos published tradecraft from autonomous AI agent campaigns, and GreyNoise traced AI-driven tooling against Check Point management servers to 99 IP addresses.
topics.why_it_matters: Agents drive multi-platform intrusions end to end, which compresses the time defenders get between a flaw's discovery and mass exploitation.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: GreyNoise tracks the Check Point campaign as GT13 and counted 24 compromised management servers at 22 organizations in financial services, energy, and government.

details.label: What to watch
details.text: Anthropic opened a public beta of Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, which flags Claude misuse spread across many requests while conversation data stays in the customer's own cloud.

sources.title: Recent Trends and Tactics of Agentic AI Attacks
The Great Escape: Tradecraft insights from an agentic swarm
Hackers Compromise 24 Check Point Management Servers in Suspected AI-Driven Attack Campaign
Anthropic wants to catch rogue AI activity without retaining your data

topics.title: FinCEN Pulls Systems Offline After Intrusion
topics.latest_developments: The Treasury Department's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network took systems offline after a cyberattack that gained unauthorized access to a limited subset of them.
topics.why_it_matters: FinCEN holds suspicious activity reports from every United States bank, so an intruder inside it sees which people and companies investigators are tracking.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Attackers also breached an open-source intelligence analysis system at the Central Intelligence Agency, adding detail to Monday's report of an unclassified system compromise.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: Colorado said criminals likely stole data on 150,000 myColorado users and knocked the state's digital identification app offline.

sources.title: Treasury's FinCEN takes systems offline after cybersecurity incident
Hackers reportedly breached CIA intelligence analysis system
Colorado says cyberattack took down myColorado app, warns 150,000 had data stolen

topics.title: Attackers Run Commands on Hex.pm Servers
topics.latest_developments: An attacker exploited a flaw rated 10.0 on Monday to run operating system commands on six production servers of Hex.pm, the Elixir and Erlang package registry.
topics.why_it_matters: Control of a registry lets one attacker poison dependencies for every Elixir and Erlang project that fetches packages from it.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: The bug had sat in the registry's code since February 2016. Maintainers moved every server to a patched build within about 15 minutes of the first malicious request.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Check WordPress installations for six WP Connect plugins backdoored on November 22, 2026 after a suspected developer account compromise. WordPress blocked the releases before publication.

sources.title: Hackers Exploited CVSS 10.0 Hex.pm RCE Flaw to Compromise 6 Package Registry Servers
WordPress Blocks Six Backdoored WP Connect Plugins Before Malicious Releases Go Live

topics.title: Bots Grab Leaked AWS Keys in Seconds
topics.latest_developments: Stony Brook University researchers Billy Tsouvalas and Nick Nikiforakis planted 300 decoy Docker images and watched bots find and use an embedded cloud access key in under eight seconds.
topics.why_it_matters: Any secret that reaches a public registry burns instantly, which makes rotation plans measured in hours or days worthless.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: VulnCheck tracked 694 exploited CVEs from January through November 2026 and found attackers used 127 of them to steal database passwords, cloud keys, API tokens, or SSH keys.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Scan container images for secrets before publishing them, and treat a leaked key as used rather than merely exposed.

sources.title: Bots exploited leaked AWS key from Docker image in under 8 seconds
Credential harvesting goes from fringe activity to major exploitation trend

topics.title: Palo Alto Patches Firewall-Rooting Fragnesia Flaw
topics.latest_developments: Palo Alto Networks patched Fragnesia after a China-linked group chained it with PHP2Shell in AI-assisted attacks that took root on 25 servers.
topics.why_it_matters: Firewalls see all traffic crossing the network edge, so root access hands an espionage group a trusted vantage point inside victim networks.

details.label: What to do
details.text: Apply the Palo Alto Networks fix on internet-facing firewalls, then hunt for PHP2Shell artifacts and unexplained root processes on the appliances.

sources.title: Palo Alto Networks Patches Fragnesia Flaw Used to Root Firewalls

business_politics.title: U.S. Prepares Tariffs Over Industrial Subsidies
business_politics.latest_developments: The Trump administration will raise tariffs on China, the European Union, and other economies over industrial subsidies, the Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday, November 25.
business_politics.why_it_matters: Importers, shippers, and exposed exporters face higher landed costs within weeks, and the move reopens trade fights with Washington's largest partners at once.

details.label: What's next
details.text: The Wall Street Journal's politics newsletter said the United States also prepares fresh sanctions on China and other nations. Markets await the formal announcement.

sources.title: China and Other Countries Face Higher U.S. Tariffs Over Industrial Subsidies
Trump says he protects 'brilliant' CEOs like Elon Musk and Jensen Huang

business_politics.title: AI Selloff Resumes as Dollar Climbs
business_politics.latest_developments: Nasdaq futures slid Wednesday, November 25, as the relief rally from Jensen Huang's reinstatement at Nvidia faded and Anthropic shares extended their decline.
business_politics.why_it_matters: The weeks-long rout in artificial-intelligence shares is spreading into industrial metals and currencies, with the dollar firming on bets the Federal Reserve tightens aggressively.

details.label: By the numbers
details.text: Gold fell close to $3,500 a troy ounce. Copper headed for one of its worst months in more than a decade. The Nikkei dropped 2.8%.

details.label: What's next
details.text: October personal consumption expenditures inflation data and the second estimate of third-quarter gross domestic product land Wednesday, with Treasury yields falling ahead of the releases.

sources.title: Tech stocks slide as confidence in AI trade fades
Nasdaq Futures Slide as AI Growth Fears Return to Center Stage
Gold Falls Close to $3,500 a Troy Ounce as Market Awaits Inflation Data

business_politics.title: Trump Shelves Business Deals With Russia
business_politics.latest_developments: President Trump shelved plans for business deals with Russia, the Financial Times reported Wednesday, November 25, dropping economic cooperation as an incentive for Vladimir Putin to end the war.
business_politics.why_it_matters: Companies positioning for sanctions relief and Russian joint ventures lose their opening, and Washington narrows its Ukraine leverage to pressure alone.

details.label: The big picture
details.text: The reversal lands as European officials warn that sabotage and arson against airports, defense plants, and other critical infrastructure keep rising.

sources.title: Trump shelves plans for business deals with Russia
Europe must not accept 'hybrid' warfare as normal, defence CEO warns

business_politics.title: Half of European Industry Under Financial Stress
business_politics.latest_developments: McKinsey found half of European industrial companies now count as stressed or distressed, putting about 3.7 million jobs at risk, the Financial Times reported Wednesday, November 25.
business_politics.why_it_matters: Lenders and bondholders across the continent face rising default risk in the manufacturing base, with layoffs likely to follow.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: The Financial Times' Monetary Policy Radar team expects further European Central Bank tightening to keep inflation from persisting, which raises borrowing costs for the weakest firms.

sources.title: Half of European industrial companies under serious financial stress
Further tightening to come from the ECB to prevent inflation persistence

business.title: Duquesne Light Blames Data Centers for Increase
business.latest_developments: Duquesne Light plans to raise default service supply rates, blaming electricity demand from artificial-intelligence data centers spreading across Western Pennsylvania, TribLive reported Wednesday, November 25.
business.why_it_matters: Hundreds of thousands of households and small businesses that never shopped for a supplier will help pay for the region's data center buildout.

details.label: Between the lines
details.text: A TribLive letter to the editor Wednesday cited a Spotlight PA finding that Pennsylvanians who shopped for electricity in 2024 paid an estimated $350 million more than utility rates.

sources.title: Data centers cited as reason for Duquesne Light rate increase
Letter to the editor: Electric choice must come with consumer protections

business.title: Trade Demand Expands Westmoreland Tech Center
business.latest_developments: Growing student interest in trade careers is driving an expansion at the Central Westmoreland Career and Technology Center, TribLive reported Wednesday, November 25.
business.why_it_matters: Construction, manufacturing, and service employers across Westmoreland County gain a bigger pipeline of trained graduates as the center adds capacity.

details.label: What they're saying
details.text: Retired bricklayer Steve Viazanko said he does not know how he would have earned a living without the workforce training he received at the center as a high school student.

sources.title: Growing interest in trade careers fuels expansion at Central Westmoreland Career and Technology Center

business.title: Oaxacan Restaurant Lulá' La Chula Opens in Etna
business.latest_developments: Meghan Raffensperger and Vladimir Martinez Rodriguez are serving Oaxacan food at Lulá' La Chula in Etna, Pittsburgh City Paper reported Wednesday, November 25.
business.why_it_matters: Etna adds a kitchen whose owners build the operation around food sovereignty and feeding neighbors, broadening the borough's dining options.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Martinez Rodriguez draws on lessons from his parents' food stand in Oaxaca. Raffensperger brings a background in sustainability work.

sources.title: Lulá' La Chula brings Oaxacan traditions — of cuisine and kindness — to Etna

around_town.title: City Council Weighs Higher Parking Fees
around_town.latest_developments: Pittsburgh City Council discussed raising parking fees to help close the city's budget shortfall, WTAE reported Tuesday, November 24.
around_town.why_it_matters: Drivers would cover part of the gap in Pittsburgh's 2027 spending plan through higher charges, a step council can take without a new tax.

sources.title: Pittsburgh City Council discusses raising parking fees to address budget shortfall

around_town.title: SNAP Enrollment Drops 19,000 in Allegheny County
around_town.latest_developments: Allegheny County's enrollment in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program has fallen by about 19,000 since new work requirements took effect, PublicSource reported Wednesday, November 25.
around_town.why_it_matters: Thousands of county residents lose grocery help in the middle of the holidays, shifting demand onto food pantries and church distributions.

details.label: What to do
details.text: PublicSource published a breakdown of the rule changes and a list of places to find food assistance near home.

sources.title: Federal food assistance is tightening, but local resources are on hand

around_town.title: Parental Leave Mandate Strains Substitute Supply
around_town.latest_developments: Allegheny County teachers welcome the new paid parental leave mandate, and districts warn it will deepen their substitute teacher shortages, PublicSource reported Wednesday, November 25.
around_town.why_it_matters: Districts gain a recruiting and retention tool, and classrooms face longer stretches of coverage because the leave stacks onto the federal Family and Medical Leave Act.

sources.title: Teachers welcome parental leave; districts brace for sub shortages

events.title: The Frick Opens Home for the Holidays
events.latest_developments: The Frick Pittsburgh opens Home for the Holidays at Clayton, its decorated holiday tour of the Frick family house, Tuesday, December 1.
events.why_it_matters: Families get an indoor holiday outing in Point Breeze that runs past New Year's Day.

details.label: When
details.text: Tuesday, December 1, 10:15 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., continuing through January 3, 2027.

details.label: Where
details.text: The Frick Pittsburgh, 7227 Reynolds St., Point Breeze.

details.label: Tickets
details.text: $4 to $25, free for children 2 and under, at thefrickpittsburgh.org.

sources.title: The Big Holiday Pittsburgh Event Guide

events.title: Jinkx and DeLa Holiday Show Plays the Byham
events.latest_developments: The Jinkx and DeLa Holiday Show, the touring drag holiday revue, plays the Byham Theater in downtown Pittsburgh Tuesday, December 1.
events.why_it_matters: The date opens December's downtown holiday calendar at a Pittsburgh Cultural Trust theater.

details.label: When
details.text: Tuesday, December 1, 7 p.m.

details.label: Where
details.text: Byham Theater, 101 Sixth St., downtown.

details.label: Tickets
details.text: $63.20 to $124.56 at trustarts.org.

sources.title: The Big Holiday Pittsburgh Event Guide

events.title: TribLive Maps the Season's Holiday Shows
events.latest_developments: TribLive published a guide Wednesday, November 25, to holiday concerts, musicals, and stage shows playing in Pittsburgh and Western Pennsylvania this season.
events.why_it_matters: Readers get one list to plan December performances around, alongside light tours and ice skating.

details.label: What they're saying
details.text: TribLive's reviewer called "Dr. Seuss' How The Grinch Stole Christmas The Musical" a high note to start the holidays.

Theater review: 'How The Grinch Stole Christmas The Musical' starts the holidays on a high note

around_teams.title: Steelers Bench Rodgers for Mason Rudolph
around_teams.latest_developments: The Steelers named Mason Rudolph their starter against the Denver Broncos and listed Aaron Rodgers inactive, one day after Rodgers and head coach Mike McCarthy took questions from reporters.
around_teams.why_it_matters: McCarthy benches a future Hall of Famer during a two-game losing streak, handing the rest of the Steelers' season to Rudolph.

details.label: When
details.text: The Steelers host Denver Friday, November 27, at 3 p.m. ET on Prime Video.

sources.title: Aaron Rodgers Press Conference (November 24) | Pittsburgh Steelers
Coach Mike McCarthy Press Conference (November 24) | Pittsburgh Steelers

around_teams.title: Farrior Joins Heyward for Thanksgiving Episode
around_teams.latest_developments: Two-time Super Bowl champion and former Steelers captain James Farrior joined Cam Heyward and Hayden Walsh on Not Just Football's Thanksgiving episode Wednesday, November 25.
around_teams.why_it_matters: Heyward's show pairs a former captain's account of the Browns brawl and playing for Mike Tomlin with a preview of Friday's game.

details.label: Zoom in
details.text: Heyward and Walsh gave away a pair of Heyward's game-worn cleats, debated whether turkey is overrated, and picked their Steelers Thanksgiving guest list.

sources.source: Not Just Football with Cam Heyward
sources.title: James Farrior On The Browns Brawl, Two Super Bowls, Mike Tomlin, & More! | Not Just Football

around_teams.title: SNR Drive Starts Its Broncos Breakdown
around_teams.latest_developments: Matt Williamson and Wes Uhler opened their Denver Broncos breakdown on SNR Drive Tuesday, November 24, picking a Broncos player to watch and working through Week 12 power rankings.
around_teams.why_it_matters: The short Thanksgiving week compresses preparation, and the show offers the first detailed look at Denver's personnel before Friday.

details.label: What's next
details.text: Williamson previewed his Week 12 statistics packet on the show.

sources.title: Beginning To Preview The Denver Broncos | SNR Drive (Nov.24) | Pittsburgh Steelers

team_usa.title: Shoulder Injury Sidelines Trinity Rodman
team_usa.latest_developments: A shoulder injury Trinity Rodman suffered in the National Women's Soccer League Championship will keep her out of the United States' Concacaf W Championship, ESPN reported Wednesday, November 25.
team_usa.why_it_matters: Head coach Emma Hayes loses her most dangerous attacker for the tournament that decides qualification for the 2027 Women's World Cup.

details.label: Flashback
details.text: Rodman played through the Washington Spirit's third consecutive championship defeat before the injury surfaced.

sources.title: Trinity Rodman ruled out of Women's World Cup qualifier with shoulder injury

team_usa.title: Copa América's U.S. Return Draws Criticism
team_usa.latest_developments: ESPN argued Tuesday, November 24, that staging the 2028 Copa América in the United States helps the men's national team and strips South America of its own tournament.
team_usa.why_it_matters: The United States men's team gets a third continental tournament on home soil in 12 years, with familiar venues and crowds before the next World Cup cycle.

sources.title: Another U.S.-held Copa América is great for USMNT but not South America
